domain_audit.fixed_bottom_pressure_column_use: Numerical connection control only; carry pending material gates into the column result. Do not infer a continuous physical T/P/composition domain from this point or the alloy curvature box.
domain_extension_requires: Exact-composition liquid stability against competing phases

implemented_hydrogen_references.silicate: Published Chaudhari buffered pressure regressions on named Fe-free experimental hosts. This is not an arbitrary-fugacity standard.
implemented_hydrogen_references.alloy: Kato dilute pure-Fe and low-Si Fe-Si references at p_H2=101325 Pa; a separate pure-Fe atomic-H mass-fraction standard includes the one-half H2 stoichiometry.
implemented_hydrogen_references.policy: No automatic replacement of archived MELTS endmember dilution or the inherited alloy H standard. The mass-based scalar is an alternative constitutive choice, not an extra dilution term.

evaluated_liquid_point.composition: bse_inventory.json dry rock, scaled to 100 g with source atom amounts preserved
evaluated_liquid_point.meaning: Local scalar/derivative and extensivity checks only; no phase selection or coupled equilibrium acceptance.

liquid_domain_evidence.restriction: Nominal limits are not a calibrated rectangle for every composition; the evaluator requires strictly positive pressure.
liquid_domain_evidence.experiment_restriction: KLB-1-derived Mg-Si-Fe-Al-Ca melt, not the full retained McDonough-Sun input or its Mg/Si variants.

standards.MELTS: Full pure-liquid-endmember standards at supplied T/P; native G and mu are divided by common R*T once. Native mixing is already included.
standards.alloy: Source Fe/Si/O standards plus Ma formal-minus-source shifts; atomic H standard must be supplied independently. No absolute standard values are supplied by the excess model.
standards.gas: Consumer supplies mu0(T) at declared p0 plus ideal ln(y*P/p0); reaction-cycle alignment to MELTS/alloy is not established by EOS.
standards.H2_augmentation: Consumer supplies a scalar molecular-H2 standard and reciprocal host dilution; native MELTS H2O must not receive an additional H2O dissolution correction.
standards.upper_column: A continuous thermochemical law and shared-species contact alignment remain pending; frozen-temperature controls do not establish these.

missing_material_evidence.required: Supported H standard/interaction and partition calibration on the declared Fe-rich composition domain.
missing_material_evidence.partial_evidence: Low-pressure pure Fe and Fe-Si H data are implemented as restricted references; O-bearing Fe-Si-O-H and 2173.15 K remain uncalibrated.

missing_material_evidence.required: Pressure response or a quantitatively justified pressure restriction; the present Ma excess model is pressure independent. Pressure independence of the different high-pressure Mg partition fit is not supporting evidence.
Independent reaction-cycle audit of MELTS, gas and alloy standards; elemental gauges cannot repair reaction-energy errors.

Convert experimental H2 mass ppm and its fugacity convention to MELTS endmember amounts, and establish calibration overlap. A buffered pressure fit or supercritical binary EOS is not a direct replacement standard.
missing_material_evidence.partial_evidence: Host-restricted mass-ppm regressions and an extensive mass-fraction scalar are implemented. The original Hirschmann mole denominator and arbitrary-fugacity BSE standard remain unverified.

missing_material_evidence.required: Stable liquid evidence for the exact BSE projection, redox/water states and Mg/Si range, including competing phases.
Supported Mg metal and Al/Ca/K/Ti/Cr/P gas/metal transfer estimates, plus their effect on coupled partition and metal boundaries.
Prescribed temperature rule, geometry, top pressure, bottom-pressure range and continuous common thermochemistry.

omission_error_budget.origin: Explicit engineering acceptance targets, not literature-derived uncertainty estimates.
omission_error_budget.rule: Compare with a supported expanded-channel or bounded model, including incipient alloys; restricted-model zeros are not an omission bound. A vanished atmosphere or boundary outside the search domain remains unresolved.

initial_omission_inventory_bounds.basis: All atoms of the omitted-transfer elements moved out of the baseline dry rock; strict inventory upper bounds on those atoms' mass only.
initial_omission_inventory_bounds.interpretation: These loose bounds do not establish small transfer: retained background atoms are 5.317% and Mg is 22.830% of dry rock; K alone is 1.712% of initial H+He mass. Associated O/H mass and chemical/phase-boundary response are not bounded by these figures.
